profile.headline: Senior Technical Product Owner driving operational optimization and future state products.
profile.summary:
I’m a results-driven technology professional with a strong background in software development, product analysis, and product management. With a proven ability to deliver cost-effective, high-performance solutions, I thrive at the intersection of business strategy and technology. My experience spans corporate environments and entrepreneurial ventures, where I've led cross-functional teams, driven digital product development, and optimized systems for maximum efficiency.

Currently, I work as a Senior Technical Product Manager at Bear River Insurance, where I play a key role in agile development cycles, backlog grooming, systems analysis, UI/UX design, and stakeholder communication. I also founded and ran Triblee.com, an e-commerce platform where I managed everything from vendor onboarding and SEO to site analytics and marketing strategy.

I bring strong technical skills in tools and languages such as Visual Studio, Azure, .NET6, WordPress, PHP, HTML/CSS, and more, along with a data-driven mindset and a passion for solving real business problems through smart technology. Whether improving internal systems or launching customer-facing products, I focus on building strong relationships and delivering measurable impact.

positions.title: Technical Project Manager
positions.description:
Own the technical vision, prioritization, and execution for high-performance engineering squads. Responsible for translating strategic business capabilities into technical requirements, managing complex backend dependencies, and driving delivery across multi-system architectures.

​Key Responsibilities:

​Technical Backlog Ownership: Author high-quality, deeply detailed technical user stories, acceptance criteria, and documentation for complex backend services, APIs, and data pipelines.

​Architecture & Delivery Alignment: Collaborate closely with Architects, Lead Engineers, and technical teams to ensure the product roadmap aligns with underlying system capabilities.
​Dependency & Risk Management: Proactively identify, map, and mitigate cross-team technical dependencies, unblocking engineering squads to maintain a high development velocity.

​Stakeholder Translation: Serve as the primary conduit between non-technical business leaders and engineering teams, translating strategic goals into technical execution.

​Agile Governance: Lead core Scrum ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Daily Standups) ensuring the team always has a 2-3 sprint runway of fully refined, ready-to-build items.

positions.title: Software Developent & Product Managment
positions.description:
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and senior leadership to define system design for Duck Creeking Billing implementation, architecture and requirements to modernize how the core business functions operate.

Provide in-depth insight into product mapping, sequence, data flow, process flow diagrams, gap analysis and data structures.

Provide code reviews, coding, configuration, basic system analytics, and solutions to complex business needs.

Extensive knowledge of SaaS platforms, Beyond Compare, Trace programs, Visual Studio, Azure, SQL, ADO, SCRUM, VMWare, Kanban, APIs and Cloud Services, Duck Creek Technologies.

Perform analytics on current-state data structures, multi-system integration, cloud services and object-oriented concepts.

Communicate at a high level with BA/QA team and senior leadership to produce accurate system documentation, requirements and test cases to optimize business needs in a future-state.

I actively participate in testing system/code, system security audits, sprint planning, scrum, integration implementation, DNS Configuration and more.
positions.insights: Management, Property and Casualty Insurance and +4 skills

positions.title: Senior Techical Product Manager / Process Engineer
positions.description:
Managed multiple technical products and developed new future-state processes to ensure optimized production at many large high-volume container ports. 

Extensive knowledge of SaaS platforms, Beyond Compare, Trace programs, Visual Studio, Azure, SQL, APIs, Cloud Services, ADO, Jira and agile process such as SCRUM and Kanban.

Provide in-depth insight into product mapping, sequence, data flow, process flow diagrams, gap analysis and data structures and applied insight to container ports current processes. 

Utilizing my experience in multiple roles to provide real time risk assesment for MGUs at multiple high volume container ports to maintain proper coverages and safety goals. 

Stood abreast of trends across various industries to ensure detection and mitigation rules are in line with the current threat landscape; streamlined company processes and saved millions of dollars in potential costs.

Maintained knowledge and familiarity with new technologies and techniques available for key performance reporting and data analysis.

Working as a Chair of Regional Quality improvement team for 3 years.

Developed and maintained prevention rules, including periodic review of rule performance.

positions.description: Triblee.com is a place people can come to sell their handmade items, along with boutique style clothing. The concept is designed around saving the online sellers time and money by platform design and simplicity.
